senses.gloss: to impart the character of an appointed meal.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 105a:2">Pes. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>נפסיק ונִקְבְּעֵיה לשבתא</he> let us interrupt our meal, and (resuming it) appoint it as a Sabbath meal; <he>לא … שבתא קָבְעָה נפשה</he> you need not interrupt your meal, the Sabbath itself makes it an appointed meal.

<cite ref="Beitzah 34b:6">Bets. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דאמר … ק׳ ליה עילויה</he> as soon as he says, ‘from here I will take to eat to-morrow’, he makes it an appointment (and it is subject to tithes); a. e.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 33:21">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIII, 21</cite> <he>מ׳ אבנין וכ׳</he> (not <he>מִקְבַּע</he>) beset with precious stones; Y. II <he>מקבעין אבנין וכ׳</he> precious stones are set (in it).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:15">Targ. Esth. VIII, 15</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <cite ref="M02570"><he>מְקוּבַּע</he></cite>, <he>מְקוּבָּעִין</he> some eds. (Hebr. forms).
